subject: Project update and scheduling conflict
text:
Good morning,

I hope you are doing well. I wanted to give you a quick update on the project before our next check-in. The research summaries are now complete, and I have placed the first two files in the shared folder. They include citations, key points, and short notes for the discussion section. I am currently reviewing the third file, and I expect to finish it by Thursday evening. The slide outline is also ready, though it needs a brief conclusion. I plan to add that after we confirm the final presentation format.

I also wanted to mention a scheduling issue. I have a conflicting commitment Friday afternoon, so I will not be able to join the work session as planned. I am sorry for the short notice, and I understand this may affect timing for the group. To reduce impact, I can finish the outline during the morning and send it before lunch. I can also record a short walkthrough so the team can follow along in advance. If helpful, I can join the early part of the session before I leave, or we can arrange a separate time to review the material.

Please let me know which option works best. I appreciate your flexibility, and I am happy to adjust my task list so the project stays on track. I will keep you updated.
